messages.author: 29f08a8088fe8c0a
messages.subject: QTL analysis on F3 single plants
parts:
Hello Dr. Broman and group

Due to some failures with growing F2 I want to try different approach for using rqtl. I am thinking on taking 2 F3 seeds from each F2 plants, plant them in total of 500 plants and conduct the qtl analysis by genotyping and phenotyping all 500 single plants. What do you think? Am I going to far with my thoughts or whether it is feasible?
What are the consequences of it?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: QTL analysis on F3 single plants

Genotyping and phenotyping the F3 plants seems a perfectly reasonable strategy, though I don't have any particular suggestions or experience with this.
